dict.string: Math Tutor uses the camera only when you tap the camera row in the tutor's message box, to take a photo of a worksheet or a page of a book so the tutor can read it. The photo is sent to Math Tutor's server and on to OpenAI, which does not use it to train its models but can keep it for up to 30 days to check for misuse before deleting it. Nothing is posted anywhere or shared with anyone else.

Math Tutor records your voice while you dictate a message, and during a live voice chat for as long as the chat is running. Recordings go to our server and to OpenAI to power the tutor, and a copy can stay with your session history. OpenAI does not use your voice to train its models.
